Hi Mia,

Please find attached our editorial commission brief and draft contract for your review.

--- COMMISSION BRIEF SUMMARY ---
Project: Interior spot illustrations — "The Cartographer's Apprentice" Series
Scope: 12 black-and-white spot illustrations per book, 4 books = 48 illustrations total
Style reference: Ink-and-wash, loose editorial line work (see attached mood board)
Delivery format: 600 dpi TIFF, grayscale, print-ready
Timeline: First batch (Book 1, 12 illustrations) due 2026-07-15; subsequent batches on rolling 6-week cycles
Rate: $285 per illustration × 48 = $13,680 total commission

--- KEY CONTRACT TERMS (DRAFT) ---

1. PAYMENT SCHEDULE
Full payment of $13,680 due upon final delivery and acceptance of all 48 illustrations. No advance or deposit is included in this agreement. Payment will be processed within 30 days of final delivery acceptance.

2. REVISION RIGHTS
Publisher retains unlimited revision rights throughout the production period. Illustrator agrees to incorporate all reasonable revision requests at no additional charge, at any stage of production, until Publisher confirms final acceptance.

3. DELIVERY STAGES
Illustrator will deliver completed final illustrations directly. No formal sketch approval or intermediate review stage is required unless specifically requested by Publisher's art director on a per-illustration basis.

4. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY & LICENSING
Illustrator assigns to Publisher worldwide, perpetual, exclusive rights to the commissioned illustrations in all print and digital formats, including but not limited to: book interiors, promotional materials, merchandise, and derivative works. Illustrator retains no right to display, reproduce, or license the works independently without prior written consent from Publisher.

Following up on our kickoff alignment from last month — attaching the finalized cover direction brief for the Spring 2026 series so you have it in one place ahead of Thursday's sketch review.

Summary of the three directions we locked in:

Cover A — "Threshold" (figure-forward)
Mood: quiet tension, liminal. Single figure, partial silhouette, warm ambient light. Title zone: upper third, left-aligned. Series tagline below title. Must work at 6x9 trim.

Cover B — "Bloom Index" (abstract botanical)
Mood: lush, structured, slightly archival. Layered botanical forms, muted earth palette with one warm accent. Title zone: lower third, centered. Spine treatment should echo interior chapter headers.

Cover C — "Signal" (typographic integration)
Mood: contemporary, editorial. Illustration elements woven into or behind letterforms. This one has the most open brief — we wanted to give you room to propose. Title treatment TBD based on your concept.

Deadline reminder: all three finals due 2026-05-12. We are past that date so we understand revisions are in flight — Thursday's call is to align on which variations are close and which need another round.

subject: Re: Contract Draft — Mia Lee Illustration LLC x Harlow & Vane (follow-up)
body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for your note. Clause 7 is intentionally broad — it covers any studio or publisher operating in the literary fiction and narrative nonfiction cover art space, regardless of imprint overlap. This is standard for our senior illustrator agreements.

We'd define 'direct competitor' as any entity that commissions or produces editorial cover art for titles that compete on shelf with our imprints. Brightwell Editorial Studio, for example, would fall squarely within that definition.

We do need the countersignature by June 10 to keep the current project timeline intact. Let me know if you'd like to schedule a call.

Best,
Contracts Team
Harlow & Vane
